title: Coalition of AI giants, labor unions proposes uniform guardrails for Indiana data centers
source_used: Mirror Indy (FPI News), 5 Oct 2026; The Republic News and Kokomo Tribune carried it later
key_facts: The American Infrastructure Alliance (AIA), a multi-million-dollar cohort of 20 organizations including AI companies, labor unions and investors, launched a campaign in Indiana for tighter guardrails on new data centers while pushing back against local moratoriums.

The AIA began in September working with local and state officials; the standards include large energy users paying their own electricity costs, clear environmental standards and enforceable commitments on costs, water use and community benefits.
It is launching efforts in seven states: Indiana, Texas, Georgia, Ohio, Iowa, Pennsylvania and South Carolina.
At least 24 Indiana counties have passed moratoriums on data centers and three have banned them, per an August Indiana University report.
An August AIA-funded survey found just over two-thirds of Hoosiers hold negative views of data centers; support for more data centers rises from 19% to 44% when the AIA guardrails are in place.
Digital Realty, which proposes a 476-acre data center campus in Kokomo, and the electrical workers' union IBEW are AIA members.
quote_evidence: A national coalition of AI companies, labor unions and investors is launching a campaign in Indiana calling for tighter guardrails on new data centers while pushing back against local moratoriums.

But the poll also found opposition to data centers drops significantly when the alliance’s proposed guardrails are in place, with the percentage of those supporting more data centers in Indiana jumping from 19% to 44%.
why_it_matters_hint: An industry and union coalition is lobbying for common rules instead of local bans.
notes: OLDER STORY: pool item is The Republic News of 10 Oct, a republication of Mirror Indy/FPI News of 5 Oct (also Kokomo Tribune 7 Oct). Lee Enterprises pages hide the article body behind a subscription wall; the body was not decoded. The poll was funded by the alliance itself.
